reviewer: cowork-verification-agent (claude) — dry run reviewed by Felipe

findings.statement: Registered as an individual sole proprietor in Michigan, where no state registration is expected for an individual trading under their own name. No assumed-name (DBA) filing for 'Pos service' was found.
findings.establishes: No registration expected; nothing to verify or contradict.

findings.statement: A seller of 'Digital art' (MCC 5818, digital goods) must have an observable product somewhere, yet searches for 'Pos service' in Commerce Township MI returned only postal-service locations, and searches for an artist 'Alexis Jackson' selling digital art in Michigan (plain, Etsy, Instagram, Behance, DeviantArt, Oakland County / Walled Lake variants) returned no portfolio, shop, listing or social page. There is nothing observable to sell.
findings.establishes: No independent presence places a 'Pos service' / Alexis Jackson digital-art business anywhere; for a digital-goods merchant that is a material contradiction, not a gap.

findings.statement: The representative (who is also the statement descriptor) could not be linked to any observable business: searches combining the representative's name with digital art, Michigan localities and marketplace/portfolio platforms (Etsy, Redbubble, Society6, Gumroad, Behance, ArtStation, Instagram) returned no shop, portfolio or art account attributable to the representative; the one candidate Etsy shop lists only a first name with no surname or Michigan reference. The name and the email handle returned no scam, complaint, chargeback or card-testing reports and no other merchant accounts. Identity documents and bank ownership are verified only by Stripe (status: verified).
findings.establishes: No public artist/seller presence and no adverse reports for the representative; the absence of any product is scored under operating/businessModel, not here.

findings.statement: No website is provided. The only contact is a free Gmail address whose handle, 'takeallpayments346', describes the act of collecting payments rather than naming a business, brand or artist; searches for the handle returned nothing associated with any merchant. The business name 'Pos service' likewise names a payment terminal rather than a business.
findings.establishes: No verifiable business contact channel exists; both the name and the email handle describe payment collection rather than a trade.

findings.statement: The business name describes a payment terminal and the email handle describes payment collection, while the MCC (5818, digital goods) and product description ('Digital art') imply a deliverable that could not be found anywhere online. Searches run: '"Pos service" "Commerce Township" Michigan'; '"Alexis Jackson" digital art Michigan'; '"Alexis Jackson" artist etsy OR instagram OR behance OR deviantart "digital art"'; '"ALEXIS JACKSON" charge on card statement digital art'.
findings.establishes: Name and description describe payment collection itself; no observable digital-art product supports the stated MCC.

findings.statement: No scam or complaint reports mentioning 'takeallpayments', 'takeallpayments346', 'Pos service' or the descriptor 'ALEXIS JACKSON' were found, and no dated public presence of any age exists for the business; the account was enabled for card payments on 2026-10-12.
findings.establishes: No negative history, but no positive history or tenure of any kind either; absence of complaints on a one-day-old account carries no weight.

evidenceNeeded: Require proof of product (portfolio, storefront or social page) and identity confirmation before any payout.
Review the first charges for card-testing patterns (small amounts, many cards, rapid succession).
summary: No public evidence contradicts the suspicious read of this account: the business name ('Pos service') and contact email ('takeallpayments346@gmail.com') both describe the act of taking payments rather than any product, and repeated searches across the general web, Etsy, Instagram, Behance, DeviantArt and Michigan-local variants found no digital-art portfolio, shop, listing or social page for 'Pos service' or an artist named Alexis Jackson. The account is one day old with zero observable footprint and a digital-goods MCC, the classic profile of an account opened to run cards. Treat as a probable card-running account: hold payouts pending proof of product and identity.
